config.label: Identify your own client
config.description: Identify your own client. This project's identifier and a contact address stay appended, so a catalogue can always reach a human.

config.label: Minimum milliseconds between requests to one catalogue
config.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests to one catalogue. Default and floor 1000, ceiling 60000. The floor cannot be lowered.

config.label: Deadline for one request, in milliseconds
config.description: Deadline for one request, in milliseconds. Default 20000.

config.label: Retries on a busy catalogue
config.description: Retries on a busy catalogue. Default 3.

config.label: In-memory cache lifetime, in milliseconds
config.description: In-memory cache lifetime, in milliseconds. Default 300000. Set 0 to turn it off.

config.label: In-memory cache size, in entries
config.description: In-memory cache size, in entries. Default 500.

config.label: error, info or debug
config.description: error, info or debug. Default error. Logs go to stderr.
